name: place_order
description: Submit a new order. Bracket legs are signed offsets from the entry working price, not absolute prices.

brackets.description: Bracket (OCO/OSO) legs. Each bracket has a profit target and/or stop loss. Total bracket qty must not exceed order qty.

breakeven.description: Price at which to move stop to breakeven

profitTarget.description: Profit-target offset from the entry's working price (signed, contract-native units). NOT an absolute price.

stopLoss.description: Stop-loss offset from the entry's working price (signed, contract-native units). NOT an absolute price.

trailingStop.description: Enable trailing stop on the stop loss leg

expirationTime.description: ISO-8601 datetime when the order expires (required when timeInForce is GTD, must be in the future)

limitIfTouchedPrice.description: Trigger price for LimitIfTouched orders (required when orderType is LimitIfTouched)

price.description: Limit price (required for Limit, StopLimit, TrailingStopLimit, LimitIfTouched) or trigger price (required for MIT)

stopPrice.description: Stop/trigger price (required for Stop, StopLimit, TrailingStop, TrailingStopLimit)
